versification: R. H. Charles source numbering normalized to logical chapters 1-108 and contiguous integer verses; lettered subverses and parallel E/G^g readings are preserved in merged text/source_parts

verses.text_en: And thence I went 〚towards the east〛, into the midst 〚of the mountain range〛 of the desert, and I saw a wilderness and it was solitary, full of trees =and plants=.
verses.text_hr: Odatle odoh 〚prema istoku〛, usred 〚gorskoga lanca〛 u pustinji. Vidjeh samotnu pustoš punu drveća =i biljaka=.

verses.text_en: Rushing like a copious watercourse [which flowed] towards the north-west it caused =clouds= and dew to ascend on every side.
verses.text_hr: Jureći poput obilna vodotoka [koji je tekao] prema sjeverozapadu, podizala je =oblake= i rosu na sve strane.
